Eternal Peptides

US-based vendor· Scored August 2026· eternalpeptides.com

Eternal Peptides tests through Janoshik Analytical, an ISO 17025-accredited laboratory in the Czech Republic with a public verification portal at janoshik.com. Any COA reference number can be cross-checked directly against the lab's own database - the strongest traceability model available in the Moderate band. Gaps include the absence of endotoxin testing and limited buyer payment protection options.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Community-commissioned tests via Finnrick.com have rated multiple batches 'A Great' across purity and content accuracy metrics. BPC-157 purity confirmed at 98-100% across 7 independent samples. Melanotan II tested at top marks. Strong independent test track record for core compounds.
Community Experience
Positive reputation among budget-conscious researchers for pricing combined with Janoshik verification. Some concerns noted around the absence of a Trustpilot profile and limited payment protection options. Community generally views the Janoshik public portal as a meaningful trust signal.
Scoring Notes
Janoshik public portal - the strongest traceability model in the Moderate band
Eternal Peptides uses Janoshik Analytical, ISO 17025-accredited, with a public verification portal at janoshik.com. Any COA reference number can be independently checked against the lab's own database. This is genuinely harder to fake than a vendor-hosted PDF. The traceability architecture exceeds several vendors scoring in the High band on other dimensions.
No endotoxin testing - a genuine gap for injectable formats
Endotoxin (LAL) testing is not currently performed according to available review documentation. For researchers using injectable formats, endotoxin is a meaningful quality parameter. This is the clearest path to a higher completeness score.
No credit card acceptance documented
Available review sources do not confirm credit card acceptance. The VTS treats credit card acceptance as a legitimacy signal because payment processors independently vet vendors. Crypto-only or Venmo-only payment removes that vetting layer and reduces the policy transparency score accordingly.
